caption:
Liberty Figure profilingizda 🗽

Telegram NFT sovg‘asi Liberty Figure #45183 ni ijaraga oling: 3 kundan 30 kungacha profilingizda ko‘rinib turadi. Kuniga 850 so‘m, 30 kunga −7%.

Liberty Figure #45183: Fedora belgisi — atigi 0,2%, Navy Blue fon 1,2%, Aquamarine modeli 3%.

Ijaraga olish: @ArendagaGiftBot — havola profilda.

#telegram #nft #telegramgifts #nftsovga #ijara #uzbekistan

concept.title: Chizma
concept.hook: Birinchi kadr — to‘q ko‘k chizma varag‘ida (to‘r, ramka, aylanalar, o‘lcham chiziqlari) ulkan akvamarin Liberty Figure; tepada "Telegram NFT sovg‘a ijarasi / Kuniga 850 so‘m"; 0,3 s da mash’al qahrabo rangda chaqnaydi, chiziqlar yonadi va figura sakraydi
concept.format: Texnik chizma (yangi): ikki chizma yorlig‘i, har biri o‘zidan figuragacha chiziq tortadi — "Liberty Figure / Fedora belgisi — atigi 0,2%", "Profilingizda turadi / 3 kundan 30 kungacha"; keyin narx, bot va havola
concept.why: Qamrov post sayin pasaymoqda (886 → ~200 → ~140 → ~100), sababi noma’lum va hech bir dizayn o‘zgarishi uni qimirlatmadi. Shuning uchun doim amal qilgan qoidalar: gift — yulduz, katta va harakatda, palitra uning o‘z ranglaridan (Navy Blue fon → chizma ko‘ki, mash’al qahrabosi urg‘u), 0-kadrda mahsulot va narx, kam so‘z, qulay sur’at. Hech qachon ko‘rsatilmagan gift (#45183).
concept.differs: Format (texnik chizma, yetakchi chiziqli yorliqlar — yangi), ko‘rinish (ko‘k chizma varag‘i — yangi), palitra (chizma ko‘ki + qahrabo + akvamarin), shrift (Chakra Petch + Space Mono — so‘nggi o‘ntada yo‘q), musiqa (calm, G-major, 74 bpm, seed 307), yangi draft.wav tovushi, gift (Liberty Figure #45183 — birinchi marta)
